sloka: निःश्वसद्भिस्तदातैतुभुजगैरर्धनिःसृतैः ।सपताकैवाभातिसतदाधरणीधरः।यद्वा -निःश्वसद्भिः तदा तैः तु भुजगैः अर्ध निःसृतैः ।स पताक इव आभाति स तदा धरणी धरः ॥४-६७-४७॥
transliteration: niḥśvasadbhistadātaitubhujagairardhaniḥsṛtaiḥ ।sapatākaivābhātisatadādharaṇīdharaḥ।yadvā -niḥśvasadbhiḥ tadā taiḥ tu bhujagaiḥ ardha niḥsṛtaiḥ ।sa patāka iva ābhāti sa tadā dharaṇī dharaḥ ॥4-67-47॥

translations.english: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.
